label: Item Roulette
description: Every pickup is a coin flip: the item gives what it always gives, or takes instead - armor, health and ammo go down, a weapon is lost, a powerup turns into a curse of the same length. What each item gives and takes is configurable.

cvars.label: Enabled
cvars.description: Turns the roulette on. Read on every pickup, so it can be switched at any time.

cvars.label: Take chance (%)
cvars.description: Percent of pickups that take instead of give.

cvars.label: Announce
cvars.description: Show the player what happened in the centre of the screen.

cvars.label: Armor rules
cvars.description: key=give/take per armor: shard ga ya ra. * = what the engine gives.

cvars.label: Health rules
cvars.description: key=give/take per health item: 5 25 50 mega. * = what the engine gives. Health never drops below 1.

cvars.label: Weapon rules
cvars.description: key=give per weapon (g mg sg gl rl lg rg pg bfg gh ng pl cg hmg, or default): ammo given with the weapon, * = engine. A take always removes the weapon (or does not give it).

cvars.label: Ammo rules
cvars.description: key=give/take per ammo, by its weapon (default, lg, rl, ...). * = what the engine gives.

cvars.label: Powerup curses
cvars.description: quad = damage multiplier while cursed (0.5 = half), bs = damage taken multiplier (1.5), regen = health lost per second (1). Invisibility shows a talk balloon over the head, haste is just denied.
